description: Elections Commission - I. M. Y. K. Bandara of the Polgahawela Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna - Mrs. M. M. C. N. Perera of the Polgahawela Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna
categorisation: This gazette content specifically concerns the vacation of office by members of a local authority (Polgahawela Pradeshiya Sabha) due to ceasing membership in a political party, as declared by the Returning Officer under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. This falls directly under electoral processes and the administration of local government elections, making it an Elections Gazette.
